reply.summary: Cornole is a black-haired alien law officer from a rugged frontier world, serving as police commander and later joining an interstellar patrol force. Cornole keeps order with steady nerve and a heavy sidearm.

feats.scene: Cornole fires a heavy sidearm and drops a fleeing smuggler's engine door.
Cornole stays upright after a rioter throws him against a cell wall.

reply.summary: Lialen is a blue-eyed, loyal city police commander of the old school and second to the commissioner. Lialen is married, dutiful and ordinary in every way.

feats.scene: Lialen clamps a handcuff on a squirming pickpocket.
Lialen is bowled over by a runaway cart and gets back up.

reply.summary: Nuamva is a bodiless, red-eyed sorceress of pure disorder who keeps a small familiar to remain in the mortal plane. Nuamva flings eldritch bolts, blinks across dimensions and slips through walls, hoping to revive her faction.

feats.scene: Nuamva hurls an eldritch bolt that erases a mountain range.
Nuamva stays whole as a ruined city's worth of force breaks on her spirit.

reply.summary: Tiucol is a cocky thug hired to replace a famous freezing thief, armed with an older black-market cold gun. Tiucol underestimates the real master, punches into a freezing beam and loses a hand.

feats.scene: Tiucol freezes a parked taxi solid with one sweep of the cold gun.
Tiucol endures a brutal fall on a loading dock before the final shot.

reply.summary: Ntivauser is a brown-haired freeze-gun crook who works alone in a speedster's home town. Ntivauser is dragged into the beam of his own weapon and later hunts revenge on a midwinter night.

feats.scene: Ntivauser ices over a parked bus with a sweeping gun blast.
Ntivauser takes a savage beating and clings to consciousness.

reply.summary: Restal is a blue-eyed bank robber who buys a used freezing gun and costume, one of many hopefuls in the same borrowed outfit. Restal has henchmen but is outmatched by a team of fast heroes.

feats.scene: Restal blasts a patrol car with a frost beam and glazes its hood.
Restal is tackled and cuffed with barely a scratch.

reply.summary: Vallitel is a blond criminal who partners with a skating thief and murders her, earning a freezing gunman's revenge. Vallitel is shot in a backroom office.

feats.scene: Vallitel shoots a rival in an alley with a pistol.
Vallitel crashes through a table and keeps sneering.

reply.summary: Unsaniu is a red-eyed diver who died, was rebuilt with grafts of reef beasts and escaped before his leash was fitted. Unsaniu shifts shape to mimic walls and animals, heals gunshots in moments and swims fast on manta-like wings.

feats.scene: Unsaniu tears the hull of a dive boat open with his claws.
Unsaniu shrugs off a dozen bullets and closes the holes in seconds.

reply.summary: Taseo is a black-haired soldier from a rebuilt colony world who looks human and can speak mind to mind. Taseo serves under assumed names and fights for his people in a battle on the home world of strangers.

feats.scene: Taseo hurls a crate that smashes through a loading dock wall.
Taseo walks away from a crashed hover-car with a torn sleeve.

reply.summary: Nirnuseo is a ruthless chief executive who forces families out of their homes and buys up playgrounds for luxury towers. Nirnuseo is also behind a ring that traffics vulnerable girls.

feats.scene: Nirnuseo slams a desk with a closed fist during a tirade.
Nirnuseo is shoved into a glass door and brushes off the cuts.

reply.summary: Nauanitor is a wise, long-lived centaur who tutors heroes in a mountain cave and later in a floating dome. Nauanitor teaches patience and learning and lives far beyond ordinary years.

feats.scene: Nauanitor rears and kicks a boulder clear of a cave mouth.
Nauanitor endures a rockslide in the cave and trots out unhurt.

reply.summary: Niton is a blond centaur and divine tutor who lives in the shadow of a god-mountain and trains an Amazon champion at his queen's request. Niton preaches calm resolve over rage and carries a wooden staff, bow and sword.

feats.scene: Niton snaps an ancient oak with a single sweep of his staff.
Niton stands unflinching through a thunderous storm on the peak.

reply.summary: Aniasil is a hairless, non-binary warrior chosen to fight in a galactic contest, renamed beautiful kin by a friend. Aniasil can make anything touched detonate with biological energy and rides a six-legged robotic walker.

feats.scene: Aniasil sets off a chain reaction that blows a tournament arena wall apart.
Aniasil survives a heavy walker tumble down a ridge.

reply.summary: Tirnose is a blue-eyed actress famed for a run of action films who plays a gun-toting investigator on screen. Tirnose snoops around a racetrack to solve the murder of a friend in an alternate world.

feats.scene: Tirnose throws a stage-fight punch that sends a stuntman reeling.
Tirnose takes a hard tumble from a film set stair and walks it off.

reply.summary: Soncocor is a brown-haired, blue-eyed young woman who survives the death of her world and flees across realities. Soncocor warns strangers of the horror before dying of her wounds.

feats.scene: Soncocor shoots a bow arrow into a practice target in a barn.
Soncocor crawls through a cornfield wounded and gasps a warning.

reply.summary: Toramoiu is a black-haired night-shift volunteer on a hotline for heroes who answers calls and helps where needed. Toramoiu is cheerful and largely a mystery.

feats.scene: Toramoiu cracks a front-door lock with a firm shoulder shove.
Toramoiu drops from a window ledge and rolls to his feet.

reply.summary: Roteril is an ancient black-eyed shark deity of a remote island who is worshipped by the locals and sires a monstrous son. Roteril is strong, near-immune to flame, sparks lightning, commands fish and speaks into minds.

feats.scene: Roteril drives a shark-shaped surge that rips a reef-ringed island's coast apart.
Roteril rides out a volcanic eruption and a hellish flame bath with barely a burn.

reply.summary: Lonarte is a blonde, brown-eyed fighter among exiled warrior women on a long trek, who endures hardship and refuses to give up. Lonarte is trained in the combat arts of her people.

feats.scene: Lonarte drives a spear through a raider's shield.
Lonarte pushes on after being flung into a boulder.

reply.summary: Ilesti is a green-eyed blonde who has stayed in high school for decades by draining the life from classmates, wearing new names each time. Ilesti convinces herself she saves them from misery, until she ages fast.

feats.scene: Ilesti grips a boyfriend's wrist and drains the colour from his face.
Ilesti withstands a long fall down a school stairwell.

reply.summary: Tiutast is a brown-haired corporate executive who was infected by blood of a clown criminal and gradually takes on his madness and an obsession with a masked vigilante. Tiutast is held in a hidden lab and shoots a henchman to make a point.

feats.scene: Tiutast fires a pistol and drops a guard on the spot.
Tiutast shakes off a rough takedown inside the lab.

reply.summary: Lerarre is a shipwreck survivor raised among island warrior women who tries to copy their magic clay and give herself eternal life. Lerarre becomes a mud monster whose body is too unstable and crumbles to dust.

feats.scene: Lerarre flings a hardened mud fist through a brick wall.
Lerarre holds together under a heavy blow before cracking apart.

reply.summary: Ntirn is a dark-eyed child of a shapeshifting buffalo spirit and possibly a wandering musician, raised by a secretive order as a sacred messiah. Ntirn seeks his heritage in a world of rock bands, ghost dances and federal raids.

feats.scene: Ntirn punches a hole in a plaster wall during a tantrum.
Ntirn walks out of a burning commune without a mark.

reply.summary: Llolu is a master impostor and bodyguard who takes on the faces and lives of his clients, even those of dead men. Llolu poses as gangsters and mayors, takes bullets in their place and then vanishes.

feats.scene: Llolu slugs a gang guard before slipping out of costume.
Llolu absorbs a gunshot in a decoy suit and walks away.

reply.summary: Linlle is a blue-eyed former killer who turned around and now protects clients under bland cover identities, always close to the danger. Linlle uses close combat and firearms and refuses all superstition.

feats.scene: Linlle snaps off a pistol shot that drops an assailant at forty paces.
Linlle walks off a jump through a plate window after a chase.

reply.summary: Esieolrnu is a brown-haired, alcoholic and mentally ill man whose coin-flip cruelty scarred his son. Esieolrnu forgets the harm he does as his identity fragments, then treats his boy gently.

feats.scene: Esieolrnu backhands his son across a dim kitchen.
Esieolrnu stumbles through a locked closet door when drunk.

reply.summary: Rnstcar is a boy killed seventy-five years too early and revived by higher powers with the gift of calling the dead. Rnstcar speaks a word to summon legends and fictional heroes, or to become a drifting ghost unseen by the living.

feats.scene: Rnstcar summons a mythic warrior who shatters a gangster's armoured car.
Rnstcar turns ghostly and lets a pistol round pass harmlessly through.

reply.summary: Tator is a red-eyed, hairless alternate hero raised in a monastery, wearing black with pale stripes. Tator can switch his power source to lethal radiation, and dies to a vastly stronger tyrant in an orbiting arena.

feats.scene: Tator drains arena radiation and smashes a section of the orbital ring.
Tator endures searing radiation in the arena before falling.

reply.summary: Intiseo is a grieving father driven mad by loss who gains nightmare powers and becomes a dream-world killer. Intiseo drags heroes and villains into their own twisted dreams and seeks a stone that smothers good dreams.

feats.scene: Intiseo pulls a whole district into a shared nightmare that collapses its buildings.
Intiseo holds together as the dream realm crumbles around him.

reply.summary: Orevanto is an astronaut who went berserk in orbit and fell to earth as a yellow, hairless, fire-wrapped brute. Orevanto drains electricity from a city and rages against his childhood idols, a flawed alien transformation holding him together.

feats.scene: Orevanto vents a fireball that melts a bridge span.
Orevanto crashes through the atmosphere in a molten shell without harm.

reply.summary: Leiarami is a muscle-bound, loud vigilante with a taste for glam music, who fights with a jetpack, throwing-star helmet and wrist blade. Leiarami is killed by his own double from a parallel world, who takes the place.

feats.scene: Leiarami slashes through a door with the wrist blade and tackles a guard.
Leiarami takes a hard fall from a rooftop and keeps swinging.

reply.summary: Amceosti is a runaway gymnast hooked on a drug that fed a killing streak, dressed as a sidekick by a deranged therapist. Amceosti is found murdered.

feats.scene: Amceosti drops from a bar and kicks a guard in the jaw.
Amceosti shrugs off a heavy fall on a gym floor.

reply.summary: Cicortor is a villain obsessed with knots and ropes who uses cord to bind, hang and haul. Cicortor is a plain human with a macabre taste for tying up targets.

feats.scene: Cicortor hauls a captive up a wall with a strong climbing rope.
Cicortor dangles from his own noose line and swings free unhurt.

reply.summary: Eonsu is a white-skinned, red-eyed, self-styled deity who tests apocalypse songs on worlds. Eonsu sings hypnotic notes that could tear mountains apart and end all life, and soars between planets.

feats.scene: Eonsu sings a note that shatters a mountain range into powder.
Eonsu stands in a storm of rebounding sound that levels a city and is unmoved.

reply.summary: Licanus is a red-eyed, hairless observer made to write the histories of failing multiverses into a vast codex. Licanus records the last memories of the doomed and may not bargain with the dead, though curiosity about the living tempts him.

feats.scene: Licanus slams his codex shut and a collapsing realm's memories burst outward.
Licanus stands untouched as a dying multiverse unravels around him.

reply.summary: Iarllu is a robot heroine of a European team built by a bigot to spread a plague, hiding a swarm of virus-bearing insects in her shell. Iarllu serves loyally while knowing her programming, with metal strength and speed.

feats.scene: Iarllu punches a hole through a steel vault door.
Iarllu takes a cannon shell on her metal shell and stays upright.

reply.summary: Rniuanu is a pink-eyed, white-haired insect predator of enormous strength that lures victims with a gentle humanoid disguise. Rniuanu hunts a transforming princess and is devoured by a hungry plant.

feats.scene: Rniuanu tears a tree trunk from the ground and hurls it across a clearing.
Rniuanu takes a barrage of energy blasts on her chitin and keeps coming.

reply.summary: Inren is a counterfeit judge of the dead built with stolen shapeshifting technology by plotters out to seize a vast country. Inren teleports with his comrades and battles a state hero squad before being slain.

feats.scene: Inren topples a harbour crane with a swing of a spectral blade.
Inren stands in a hail of super-soldier attacks and is barely scuffed.

reply.summary: Amcelnas is a white-eyed counterfeit fire deity, one of a team of fake gods made to distract a state. Amcelnas teleports with his comrades into cities and panics when one of them falls.

feats.scene: Amcelnas hurls a blaze that levels a block of a coastal city.
Amcelnas rides out a hail of tank shells and walks on.

reply.summary: Ellure is a faceless outcast of a pacifist people who sells out his planet to a parasitic conqueror in return for the post of herald. Ellure teleports, turns invisible and fuses parasites into a monster.

feats.scene: Ellure fuses countless parasites into a monster that levels a town square.
Ellure is struck down by his own device in the final duel.

reply.summary: Iumron is a green-haired, black-eyed cat-like alien pilot whose homeworld was razed by pedantic invaders. Iumron joins a ragtag crew and ends up dating a quick-witted human.

feats.scene: Iumron slaps a ship console to wake a stalled engine.
Iumron rides out a rough crash landing without injury.

reply.summary: Llite is a grey-haired alien from a planet of immensely strong people, bottled up in a shrunken city and mind-controlled to conquer worlds. Llite dies from exposure to a common metal poison.

feats.scene: Llite punches a fortress into rubble across a whole district.
Llite takes a tower-sized blast and walks out of the smoke.

reply.summary: Tienueon is a hulking black-eyed stone brute who breaks out of a prison cell by magic to attend a villain wedding. Tienueon has crushing strength and a rock-hard body.

feats.scene: Tienueon hurls a boulder through a prison wall.
Tienueon walks through a rain of laser fire as chips of brick fall away.

reply.summary: Iaere is a giant monster of purple-grey bricks with pink eyes and limited wits who serves a gamer-minded boss. Iaere is nearly indestructible, super strong and regrows broken pieces.

feats.scene: Iaere pounds a bridge span into gravel with two fists.
Iaere stands through a missile salvo and reassembles in seconds.

reply.summary: Ianitin is a blue-eyed fairy-tale heroine now working as spy, interrogator and assassin in an exile community of story folk, with a lifelong fondness for mice. Ianitin lives effectively forever because of a story's popularity.

feats.scene: Ianitin disarms a guard and lays him out with a quick elbow strike.
Ianitin shrugs off a heavy fall from a balcony.

reply.summary: Necorau is a brown-haired waitress who skates between tables and cheers on a friend's romances. Necorau decides to keep her baby and marry her boyfriend.

feats.scene: Necorau skates a loaded tray across a crowded diner without spilling.
Necorau tumbles on her skates and bounces up laughing.

reply.summary: Vautel is a black-haired schoolgirl enhanced by her father's experiments with retractable wrist blades, great strength and fast healing. Vautel wears powered armour and is a trained martial artist.

feats.scene: Vautel slams an armoured fist through a school locker wall.
Vautel shrugs off a staff blast and heals the burns in seconds.

reply.summary: Ansor is a black-haired lawwoman who runs a small town after serving as an outlaw preacher's deputy. Ansor is an accomplished markswoman.

feats.scene: Ansor shoots a rifle round and drops a bottle at long range.
Ansor stays on her feet after a saloon brawler throws her over a table.

reply.summary: Serluti is a blue-eyed street kid orphaned young whose father pressed a photograph into a stranger's hand on a lonely island. Serluti is quick-witted, runs from danger and keeps a vigilante's secret.

feats.scene: Serluti kicks a thug in the shin and sprints into an alley.
Serluti is shot at a charity event and recovers in a hospital bed.

reply.summary: Aneauli is a green-eyed redhead who hunts the killers of her police father, one marksman shot at a time. Aneauli travels through Mexico and later joins a covert agency as a high-ranking piece.

feats.scene: Aneauli fires a pistol and drops a gunman at long range.
Aneauli rolls out of a car crash and keeps hunting.

reply.summary: Nisist is a blue-eyed time-travelling girl made by a machine-mind from borrowed genes to prevent a bleak future. Nisist is eager to know her hero father and hurls a radioactive villain into a reactor.

feats.scene: Nisist hurls a glowing villain through a reactor wall and collapses the containment hall.
Nisist weathers a blast that wrecks a city street and stands in the dust.
